changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.COMPLIANCE_ROUTING ( ROUTING_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) NOT NULL, COUNTRY_HINT CHAR(2), DECISION VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, PRIMARY_REASON VARCHAR2(40), ALL_REASONS_JSON CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_REASONS_JSON CHECK (ALL_REASONS_JSON IS JSON), URGENCY VARCHAR2(16), ROUTED_AT TIMESTAMP(6), ROUTED_TO VARCHAR2(64), COMPLIANCE_REQUEST_ID VARCHAR2(64), COMPLIANCE_VERDICT VARCHAR2(20), COMPLIANCE_VERDICT_DETAIL CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_VERDICT_JSON CHECK (COMPLIANCE_VERDICT_DETAIL IS JSON), COMPLIANCE_RESPONDED_AT TIMESTAMP(6), STATUS VARCHAR2(16) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, VERSION NUMBER(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_COMP_ROUTING PRIMARY KEY (ROUTING_ID, CREATED_AT), CONSTRAINT FK_COMP_RESULT FOREIGN KEY (RESULT_ID) REFERENCES TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS(RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_COMP_DECISION CHECK (DECISION IN ('BYPASS','ROUTE','BLOCK')), CONSTRAINT CK_COMP_URGENCY CHECK (URGENCY IS NULL OR URGENCY IN ('STANDARD','EXPEDITED','BLOCKING')), CONSTRAINT CK_COMP_STATUS CHECK (STATUS IN ('PENDING','DISPATCHED','RESOLVED','FAILED')), CONSTRAINT CK_COMP_VERDICT CHECK (COMPLIANCE_VERDICT IS NULL OR COMPLIANCE_VERDICT IN ('PASS','REJECT','NEEDS_REVIEW','TIMEOUT')) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (CREATED_AT) INTERVAL (NUMTODSINTERVAL(7, 'DAY')) (PARTITION P_INITIAL VALUES LESS THAN (TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'));
